en: This postcard is a black and white photograph showing a wooded street lined with several wooden houses, with evergreen trees and a rustic wooden fence in the foreground. The setting appears tranquil and residential, likely depicting worker housing. The bottom left contains the printed text 'Matfors. Arbetarebostäderna.' and in the bottom right are credits to the Sundsvalls museum.
